verdict: PASS after the recorded corrections, including the explicit FamU size-to-setting guard task

checks.finding: The ten original topDesWin contracts, fixed-target class projections and constants are retained. All global templates use the same A, C=WithChN A, target-compatible Cprime and E. The design class Cdes is distinguished explicitly. The finite Closed join precedes the single DesignExists family/CH witness.

Selected AND edges contain the displayed sufficient inputs and any remaining proof-of-implication tasks. Proved certificates prove arrows only. All 29 shared-work links are explicitly nonlogical; optional routes are excluded from selected reachability. Recursive design construction is retained as a nonlogical alternative refinement of the opaque compatible DesignChoices producer, so no partial list is asserted to construct it.

DesignChoices(Cdes,3,cT), the closed TuSize implication for that same cT and Cdes, and closed eventual original RankM form the exact DEX7 sufficient cut. The host is carried by the target DESIGN_RH/GRH wrapper. The three producers remain open C tasks. DEX thinning, denominator size and numerical proviso are complete consumer implications. RecExP-after-every-level, the common QOf, and literal dependent equalities remain upstream in the alternative recursive refinement.

LOCAL_NBUILT_COMMON is a Closed producer on the original Des(C,3) class, with one eventual family of actual certificates for Fm.D(x,i). It retains NdSpec, original iV and Hecke actions, maximal-ideal coverage, Psi/range and the projection square. CERT_LOCAL_COVERAGE then gives literal LinkEta. A generic TSel is explicitly not treated as supplying NBuilt.

The producer explicitly supplies every original Fm in A with compatible original Bundle data and one eventual threshold for the conjunction RowsHold0_3 and the base theta square on the same selected P. The finite consumer may therefore use epsilon1=1,K=0. The text also states that a weaker Closed producer retains its own bounds. It does not infer thTheta from ThDef3, or require RowsHoldLam3/TupAllUsed/nonbase theta identities for this rank implication.

The open selector producer retains the actual true-column rec7 record or full dependent tuple transport, original coefficient-field roots, real witness and Duty on A. The completed finite-character and selection certificate gives Closed second layer on D3(3,A). GLOBAL_SECOND_LAYER_MATCH now directly requires the Duty-carrying producer as well as second layer and the universal mass/volume certificate, so its displayed hduty,tie,hU,hG conclusion has complete direct premises.

The exact inclusion is Closed on D3(3,A), with one eventual threshold before all original x,i,u,w|T_u. Taking this inclusion as an input, actual nuDef, ex.lat.atT, nprimeDef and nuIn prove fullness. Original T mod 4 = 1 and primality give T>=3 pointwise, so the nonzero actual orbit slice proves positive rank without full HidaSetting. The source-facing TuSize parameter can be retained unused. The completed bare-inclusion RSL11-RSL12 implication therefore does not need the new size-to-setting task. The graph's selected stronger operator-based supplier of the inclusion does need that task. Fullness descendants still contain no GL4 task or final slope assembly.

FamU is eventual (HidaSetting D u -> P D u), not unconditional eventual P. D3 membership supplies TuSize only. The newly explicit B task TASK_GL6_SIZE_SETTING reconstructs TuSize -> SettingEventually on the original family, through numsL_wtsL_fam and levelPrime_setting_of_sizes. It supplies all setting clauses, including alcove bounds and bTop>=0, and activates the conditional FamU operator contracts. It is required by both GLOBAL_RAMIFIED_INCLUSION's selected stronger supplier and TASK_LINK_GL_INSTALL. The bare-inclusion-to-fullness certificate remains separate.

The three full GL6 operator/length contracts are shared stronger suppliers of the weaker inclusion, not declared completed by it. The full slope route still retains the h3 installation, three GL4 tasks, three GL6 operator/length tasks, the size-to-setting task, congruence-length implication and final numerical/lattice assembly. The mass/volume and ramified-model certificates are used only in their stated original-object scope. Duty/ChosenWall and the literal constants remain in the final assembly contract.

Ordinary RH still reaches I, II and V and excludes the Case-III producer; unrestricted Dirichlet GRH reaches Case III as well. The fixed 2-primary target restriction is not promoted to universal CountIII. The original Count-II same-ideal coupling and the rank-specific source boundaries are inherited unchanged.

Global coverage, small rank, design and fullness are marked as completed conditional implications with open producer inputs. The full proof and arithmetic producer construction are not declared complete. Historical compound-record counts and selected-leaf counts are expressly bookkeeping, not mathematical independence or completion percentages. The formal Lean correctness premise is preserved.

resolved_findings.initial_issue: GLOBAL_SECOND_LAYER_MATCH promised hduty, but its original direct premises stated only second layer and universal mass/volume; Duty was inside a more remote producer.
resolved_findings.resolution: Added SECOND_LAYER_COMPATIBLE_SELECTION as a direct requirement. Its contract explicitly supplies Duty on the same A.

resolved_findings.resolution: The design contracts and cut now use Cdes for the construction class, while top-level C remains WithChN A.

resolved_findings.resolution: GLOBAL_RAMIFIED_INCLUSION now states its exact Closed class and the original HidaSetting/bTop>=0 guard. D3 -> TuSize is a class projection; the subsequent TuSize -> SettingEventually implication is separately retained as the new B task described below.

resolved_findings.initial_issue: The universal class producer and the zero-bound finite consumer could be read as erasing the bounds of a separately Closed producer.
resolved_findings.resolution: The producer now explicitly covers every original Fm in A and states that the weaker Closed alternative retains its own bounds.

resolved_findings.initial_issue: The source FamU contracts are conditional on HidaSetting; class membership supplies TuSize but does not itself constitute a human reconstruction of the full setting consequence.
resolved_findings.resolution: Added TASK_GL6_SIZE_SETTING to the selected guarded-operator inclusion route and full global ledger. Independently checked the exact FamU/SettingEventually definitions and settingF_of's numeric dependencies. Also checked T mod 4 = 1 from original norm/tower fields, which removes the full setting supplier from the bare-inclusion positivity argument.
